# partiteai_mcp_connection (Resource)

MCP connection resource



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Resource name

### Optional

- `http_transport` (Attributes) HTTP transport configuration for the MCP connection. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--http_transport))
- `tunnel_transport` (Attributes) Tunnel transport configuration. The server reaches mesh by connecting outwards, so it needs no inbound endpoint, and a relay speaks the tunnel protocol on its behalf. Which relays serve which conversations is decided by partiteai_mcp_connection_subscription resources. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tunnel_transport))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the resource was created
- `id` (String) Resource identifier
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the resource was last updated

<a id="nestedatt--http_transport"></a>
### Nested Schema for `http_transport`

Required:

- `url` (String) The URL of the HTTP endpoint.

Optional:

- `authentication_method` (String) The authentication method to use. Valid values are 'NONE', 'BASIC', 'HEADER', 'OAUTH2_AUTHORIZATION_CODE', 'OAUTH2_CLIENT_CREDENTIALS'.
- `basic_credentials_wo` (Attributes, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Basic authentication credentials. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--http_transport--basic_credentials_wo))
- `credentials_version` (Number) The version of the credentials. Increment this value to rotate credentials.
- `header_credentials_wo` (Attributes, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Header authentication credentials. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--http_transport--header_credentials_wo))
- `oauth_client_credentials_wo` (Attributes, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) OAuth client credentials for authentication. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--http_transport--oauth_client_credentials_wo))
